summary: Middle East tensions intensified as prospects for peace dimmed, pushing oil prices higher and pressuring bonds — a key driver of the ongoing flight to gold and the selloff in Treasuries weighing on bond sentiment. Rising yields are also snuffing equity momentum as investors simultaneously brace for the July FOMC minutes, due Wednesday, with the committee still split on the inflation outlook.
tweet: Middle East tensions are lifting oil and gold while rising yields squeeze bonds — all eyes on Wednesday's FOMC minutes for clues on the Fed's inflation split.
